# Writer Computer

> Writer Computer is a free and open-source markdown editor for macOS. It is made for people who keep their writing in plain-text folders, such as Obsidian vaults, docs repos and personal wikis, and it edits those files in place as ordinary markdown on disk.

Writer Computer is often called "Writer" for short. It is not related to writer.com, iA Writer or LibreOffice Writer.

Key facts:

- Price: free. No account, no subscription, no paid tier.
- Open source: the full source code is on GitHub.
- Platform: macOS.
- Files: opens any folder of markdown files as a workspace and edits the files in place. It does not move, rename or convert files. Pasting an image into `note.md` saves it in a `note-assets` folder next to the note.
- Folders: files excluded by `.gitignore` and hidden folders (such as `.git` and `.obsidian`) are left out of the sidebar and search. Each workspace can have its own window.
- Obsidian: follows `[[wikilinks]]` with autocomplete and shows `![[image]]` embeds. Obsidian plugins and callouts are not supported.
- Markdown: CommonMark with GitHub-flavored tables, task lists and strikethrough; Mermaid diagrams; KaTeX math with `$` and `$$`; HTML blocks such as `<details>`; YAML frontmatter shown as editable properties; syntax-highlighted code blocks. Footnotes are not rendered.
- Privacy: usage telemetry is opt-in and off by default. It never includes document contents, file names or paths. Declining sends a single event recording that choice.
- Built with Tauri v2, React, CodeMirror and Rust.
